methods.name: MASONRY
methods.description: Load-bearing fired-clay brick, hand-laid on site. Catalan tier-1 data: Hispalyt EPDs, BEDEC (ITeC), CYPE. CO2: 205-490 kgCO2e/m2 GFA. Labour: 22-34 h/m2.
methods.source_label: Hispalyt GlobalEPD 008-016/017/001 + BEDEC ITeC + CYPE FEF010/FFZ010 (Tier 1, Catalonia)

confidence_range.note: Dominant Tier-1 Catalan EPDs. No major geographic extrapolation needed.

methods.name: 3D PRINTED
methods.description: Robotic concrete extrusion. Structural walls only. Foundation, roof, and openings remain conventional. No published Catalan peer-reviewed LCA was found in the imported dataset.
methods.source_label: Mohammad 2020 + Rossi 2024 + Allouzi 2020. No Catalan peer-reviewed 3DP LCA in the imported branch.

confidence_range.note: Tier-1 sources exist, but all require geographic extrapolation to Catalonia.

methods.name: PREFAB
methods.description: Factory-built modules or CLT panel systems assembled on site. Imported dataset is lifecycle-stage based rather than the project's five construction phases, so it is not yet engine-ready.
methods.co2_note: Range spans CLT with biogenic credit, CLT without biogenic credit, and modular-concrete references.
methods.source_label: Andersen 2022 + Wei 2024 + Stora Enso EPD. No Spanish/Catalan primary prefab LCA in the imported branch.

confidence_range.note: Useful evidence exists, but the imported dataset still needs phase mapping and transport normalization for the project engine.

methods.name: RECLAIMED BRICK
methods.description: Salvaged fired-clay brick, cleaned and relaid. Imported as a baseline floor rather than a fully comparable fourth competitor. The allocation rule can swing the structure CO2 result by roughly 5x.
methods.co2_note: Structure-focused baseline. Foundation and roof remain conventional in the imported dataset.
methods.source_label: RBC EPD 2024 + Salmio and Huuhka 2026 + De Wolf 2020 + Devenes 2022. No Catalan primary reclaimed-brick LCA in the imported branch.

confidence_range.note: Strong methodology signal, but no Catalan primary data and very large sensitivity to allocation-rule choice.

phases.name: FOUNDATION
phases.description: Structural base. Reinforced concrete strip or slab. Load transfer to ground.

phases.name: STRUCTURE
phases.description: Load-bearing envelope or frame. Primary contributor to embodied carbon.

phases.name: ROOF
phases.description: Weatherproofing layer. Conventional in most imported branch scenarios.

phases.name: OPENINGS
phases.description: Windows and doors. Often conventional even when the structure method changes.

phases.name: FINISHING
phases.description: Interior and exterior surfaces such as render, plaster, paint, and tile.

comparison_insight: The imported branch data is strongest when it exposes trade-offs and confidence, not when it pretends to offer one final winner. Masonry is best anchored in Catalan source material. 3D printing and prefab rely more heavily on external proxies. Reclaimed brick is useful as a methodological baseline, especially because its result changes dramatically with the allocation rule.
